title: Asahina Mafuyu — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Okay, the lyrics are pretty much done. All that's left is to fine-tune them...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm logging off for the night. I'll probably have the lyrics ready for you by tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, wait! Would you mind staying up until midnight?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Once the clock strikes midnight, it's your birthday! We wanted to wish you happy birthday right on the dot.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So that's why you were all online early.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Exactly. Hey, you could try sounding a little more excited, you know.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The fact that it's my birthday doesn't make today any different. I think people at school might wish me a happy birthday, though.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And while you guys were busy chatting, look, it's five seconds 'til midnight!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright. We'll put on a proper celebration for you another time!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Make sure you actually get some sleep tonight.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I should get some sleep.
Time to log out of Nightcord...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, good morning, Mafuyu.
Aaand, happy birthday♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate B
rows.Line: Here, this is from us! They're lemon-flavored madeleines from the patisserie in front of the station! They're amazing!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you both! Oh, this is the place you told me about before, right? The one that went viral online?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah! We tried them ourselves before buying them, and there's no denying that they're good!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate B
rows.Line: Not only did we get to stuff ourselves there, but thanks to that we knew that these would be the perfect gift for you! Talk about a double win!

rows.Speaker: Junior Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Oh, Asahina, happy birthday! We got you a gift!

rows.Speaker: Junior Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Um...please accept my birthday gift, too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for coming all the way to the second years' classrooms, and thank you so much for these gifts.

rows.Speaker: Junior Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Our pleasure, Asahina! We'll see you at club after school!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Asahina, are you free to talk for a moment?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori? Oh, and Hoshino and Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since it's your birthday today, I invited them over so that we could all give you our presents at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, they're gloves. Hehe, they look so thick and warm!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I thought you might need them since it's going to stay cold for a while. I hope they come in handy!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Of course. I'll be making good use of these.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday. We also got something for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were really stuck on what to get you, but in the end, we settled for this deep sea snow globe.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like it's snowing underwater. It's so sparkly and pretty!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you, I'll make sure to treasure this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad she likes what we got her!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it's all thanks to Kanade's advice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sorry, Mafuyu. I need to apologize to you about something.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A while ago, Hoshino and Mochizuki reached out to me asking what kinds of food you like so they can get you a birthday present.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I ended up saying that it's probably best to not get you anything food-related.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyway, they seemed to understand it as your dedication to your physical fitness, given your commitment to archery...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <...but I just wanted to apologize for having said too much. I'm sorry.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hoshino, Mochizuki, it sounds like you put so much effort into this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: While I don't mind edible gifts, they disappear after I eat them, so I'm happy that I can keep this with me forever.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should go thank Ms. Yoisaki, too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't expect to receive this many gifts. I should keep note of who gave me what before I forget—
